egress.terms: Free, served from misskey.io's own CDN (Cloudflare + object storage). No egress charge.

record.chaining: The largest Misskey instance in existence (~600k users) so the best-tested API, BUT registration is CLOSED: the /api/meta description states in Japanese that new signups are suspended because the cloud provider for their servers suffered unauthorised access and they cannot add capacity. Only useful with existing accounts or an invite if the operator reopens.
record.limits_note: per-object-cap 500 MiB; per-user 10 GiB; request-rate is the real constraint here (huge shared IP pool, aggressive per-IP limits).
record.reliability_note: Registration closed as of this probe; operator explicitly cannot expand capacity. The 500 MiB per-object number is still the useful data point: it proves the family's per-object ceiling.
